note: Language-independent v1 vectors. invalid_structural is refused by raw schema; invalid_semantic passes raw schema but violates normative admission. selection/repetition/agreement/traces/settlement are context-dependent semantics over claims. Records are claims: no vector establishes producer truth, authorization, enforcement, durability or actor custody. No runtime qualification.

Record.name: release request narrowed to a logical child
Record.claim: scope is logical; child admission only

Record.name: request with redacted reason
Record.claim: redaction is explicit and distinct from missing

Record.name: request with missing reason
Record.claim: missing carries why; it is not a negative

Record.name: durable transport receipt
Record.claim: a durability claim still is not admission

Record.name: hold acknowledgment
Record.claim: input admission held; running work not claimed

Record.name: idempotent hold acknowledgment from an already held state
release acknowledgment from unknown prior state
Record.claim: prior hold state may be unknown

Record.name: admission-stage stale_authority refusal from the successor generation
Record.claim: staleness is recognizable and refused, not acknowledged

Record.name: transition-stage already_terminal refusal
Record.claim: a refusal is an outcome, not an absent acknowledgment

Record.name: insertion acknowledged with exact process and stream evidence
Record.claim: logical subject with attached actor evidence

Record.name: physical exit with wait completed and legacy/incomplete evidence
observation on a bare root subject
provider/v1 launch event is not a control record
live_stream control fact is not a control record
execution pause is not a v1 operation
drain is not a v1 operation
provider-native session cannot be the logical scope
redaction marker carrying the redacted text
insertion fact with a tagged-end state
physical custody fact with a logical state
incident severity is outside this slice
OOM cause is not an actor evidence kind
scope root differs from addressed root
acknowledgment by a stale or successor authority
stale_authority from the addressed authority itself
exact actor evidence with redacted reference
exact actor evidence with missing reference

selection.name: common v1 intersects operations and facts
unknown and newer entries are ignored
absent control capability is no_common_version, not provider unavailability
facts may be empty while operations agree
malformed v1 entry is refused, not skipped
v1 entry with an extra field is refused
advertisement that is not an object

repetition.name: byte-identical retry is the same request
same key re-addressed to a successor generation
new key for the same hold is independent

agreement.name: unselected release request is a capability diagnostic

traces.name: full ladder: receipt, admission, hold acknowledgment, outcome
queued-not-admitted receipt is not admission or acknowledgment
acknowledgment before admission is a violation
redelivered records are duplicates, a late receipt is still receipt
stale authority refusal then refused outcome
acknowledged hold whose authority later changed stays acknowledged with retained uncertainty
records answering another key, another generation or an observation are refused
acknowledgment of another operation under the same key
release acknowledgment is idempotent from an open state

settlement.name: ACK, tagged end and settled debt is logically settled
U112 case: ACK with absent tagged end, debt owed, then peer exit and wait
ACK with absent tagged end and no debt report is still owed
physical exit and wait alone are not logical settlement
missing insertion evidence is not non-insertion
a successor's not_inserted report does not erase an earlier ACK; the disagreement is retained
earlier generation ACK is read alongside a successor's tagged end
redacted tagged end leaves logical settlement unknown
contradictory ACK, absent end and settled debt stays unknown
observations of another logical input are not read
